text:
Asha: Quick sync — need a lightweight design-partner plan we can ship this month. Core asks: selection rubric, outreach window, basic telemetry, and success gates.

Ben: Keep it tiny. Recommend 6 partners, 4 sandbox / 2 integration. Outreach window = 5 business days. Acceptance SLA = 72h.

Liam: Eng constraints: prefer hosted-only for sandbox. For integrations, reserve one dev-day each. Telemetry minimal: session_id, event, latency_ms, feedback_tag. Example payload: {"event":"prompt","session_id":"<uuid>","latency_ms":142,"feedback_tag":"hallucination"} .

Rina: CS can run weekly 30-min check-ins. Propose mid-run 6-question survey and ask partners to record 2 short Looms of failures. I'll run outreach and calendar invites.

Asha: Success gates: onboarding completion >=80% in 72h; weekly active sessions >=2; at least 2 actionable product tickets cohort-wide by week 3. Add regression rule: pause partner if >20% increase in error rate.

Ben: Incentives: small credits + early roadmap meeting for integrations. Keep admin low.

Liam: Rollout note: route partners to smallest hosted variant first; only upgrade if latency breaches threshold for 2 days.

Rina: I'll draft invite copy and shortlist 12 candidates. Will share scoring sheet for product to review.

ops-bot: Calendar created: "Design Partner / Private Beta Kickoff" Wed 09:30 PST (organizer: Asha).

Asha: Thanks 44D. Action items: Ben finalize outreach copy by Tue; Liam provide telemetry stub + 1-line onboarding runbook by Tue EOD; Rina publish shortlist + schedule by Wed.
